segments.en: No, no, that's Dinesh, my name is Gautam.
I don't know, in the app, in the ID, it shows like that.
Okay, okay, I am from Trichy.
Okay, okay, I am married too.
I couldn't tell from your voice, so I asked.
Okay, okay, do they go to school?
The elder one is in LKG, the younger one is two years old.
I shifted here five months ago.
Okay, where in Salem are you?
I am two years older than you.
Leave it, it's okay, let it be. What if it is?
Should I not talk, or should I not be 31?
If you are okay with it, tell me.
Your voice is nice. Thank you.
What did you say? I didn't understand.
No, you were asking something, tell me. I was asking in between, sorry.
I didn't come to ask anything. Where is your wife?
Oh, has she gone to her hometown?
That's why you came here to be carefree, right?
More than me, you are the one who is carefree.
Why are you saying that? Oh, I have come here permanently, right?
How many babies do you have?
Only one girl, three years old.
It's been three or four years since you got married, right?
Okay, okay. At this time, you are speaking very clearly, I can hear you clearly. What are you doing? Are you not sleeping?
No, no, I am just keeping the phone near my mouth and talking.
Are you staying with your in-laws, or did you come here alone?
I don't have my in-laws, both of them passed away.
How are you staying alone without anyone?
I didn't take a room, I took a house.
Oh, okay, you took a house.
Actually, I have my own house here, my mother's house is nearby, I have my own house.
I have some construction work, I have to finish the pending work.
So until then, I am staying in a rented house. They are all supporting me.
I asked, how are you staying without anyone's support?
It's not like that. They are all there nearby, my mother, grandfather, grandmother, mother, father, my family, my sister's family, my brother's family.
Okay, I asked because you said you are staying alone in Attur.
This is the place where I was born and brought up. Actually, I got married in Chennai ten years ago.
After ten years, I have come now.
No, for now, there is no work. The kids are small, right?
How long have you been using this app?
I installed it a long time ago, but I am not a regular user. I come occasionally.
Hmm, same here. My wife uses it only when she goes out, otherwise I don't come.
Are you scared of your wife?
No, I am not scared, it's just that I don't want unnecessary problems.
How is she? Is she okay?
Okay, she is not too strict, not too liberal, she is okay.
Hmm, do you like your wife very much?
I don't like her very much, 70%. 30% I don't like her because we fight sometimes.
What did she study? What did you study?
I am a BE Mechanical, she is an MSc B.Ed.
So, since the baby is there, you are not going to work, right?
It's going on. How about you? How do you like your husband?
My husband and I are not a good match.
From the beginning, it was like that.
His character and mine, it doesn't match with anyone else, only with me.
I am not saying he has flaws, he is a very, very, very good person. He is a great human being.
He has a great helping tendency, he is the best father in this world, the best son, a good disciple to his guru.
But is he a good husband? If you ask, that doesn't come to him.
The way he grew up, there is a lot of age difference between him and me.
The way he grew up, in that generation, women, how his mother lived, that is, whoever said anything, she wouldn't answer back.
She would hide behind the door and answer back, like that.
He expects the same thing from me. How is that possible?
So many generations gap, so you are in such a generation, how can you do that?
How, like, 'Hey, give me tea, give me coffee', if I say my name and ask for tea, even if I ask ten times, he won't give it.
If I ask for money, he won't give it.
If I say 'Hey, give me tea', if I say it, those who want to do it won't do it.
That is his nature. He will talk like that. His way of talking, tone, nothing is for us.
Because I have also studied, I have also studied, I am also a good, what to say, I lived in a better condition than him, I am a well-educated girl, at a young age.
Then why did you get married at this age? It should be like that, right?
That is another issue, leave it.
That is a big issue, then?
Actually, you are talking about such a sad thing and smiling slightly, you are talking, right? It changes suddenly.
That is because I got used to it.
Because he, you know, I am completely, I have come out of him.
In my mind, he is not clean, because he has hurt me that much.
That is, now, how do you know?
If I tell you one, just one thing, you will understand it completely.
Like, now, in my house in Chennai, people come to do house work, to wash dishes, to clean the house, they come and go.
Until then, he talks to me nicely, he talks while smiling in the morning.
When I enter inside before 10 o'clock,
I will ask, 'You were talking nicely all this time, why are you doing this in front of someone?' Not someone, someone, I want to insult him in front of someone.
Then, if you want to insult your wife in front of another third person, it means you don't have love for her.
If you really had love for her, you wouldn't do such a thing.
Even if he did, if we talk within four walls, it's okay.
Yes, yes, I am asking, I am wrong, I am wrong, I didn't do anything wrong, I really didn't do it, let what I did be there.
Is that what you are saying?
No, I am asking if anything like that happened, maybe he was talking like that.
No, I am asking if anything wrong happened, I am asking.
No, not you, I am asking if he did something like that.
Ah, he does this a lot.
This is how he treats me, this is how it is.
I have never taken money from his pocket.
He will say that I took it.
Why would I take money from his pocket? He will shout in front of others, in a way that everyone can hear.
Why, don't you have the intelligence to take money from his pocket?
How many times should I tell you not to take money from his pocket? If you touch it, it won't be understood, don't you know?
Okay, okay, okay, he talks like that, super.
Cool, cool, cool, cool, cool, cool, cool.
Okay, okay, okay, okay, okay, okay.
How can we be with a person like that?
He won't divorce, he won't give divorce.
No, no, I am asking openly, there is nothing wrong with this, I am asking you to share as much as you can.
Like that, we can be friends, but beyond that, I don't want any other relationship.
No, I don't want it, I will tell you directly, there is nothing wrong with it. You tell me, if you want to be friends, tell me.
Yes, friendship, that's it. To be honest, I am a little busy, because I have to pick up and drop off the kids, do this and that, and then in the evening I have to take tuition.
No, no, I will tell you, whenever you are free, whenever you feel like talking, you can call me. If you say friendship, it's okay.
The thing is, I don't have time. After that, I will share my ID with you, and I don't have the heart to let you suffer, that's what I am saying.
No, you don't need anything like that. Just give me your number, I will send a 'Hi' on WhatsApp.
No, I don't want the number, I will give you my Telegram ID.
No, actually, I am not telling you, I am telling you because my wife uses it, that's why I am saying, otherwise I would have given it, no problem.
Everything, WhatsApp, Telegram, everything is used. I will save it as my company's service number, that's all, nothing else.
My problem is the same, I am a little scared, that's the issue.
No, nothing, you just give me the number, I will just say 'Hi', when you are free, you call me, that's all.
Otherwise, nothing is good. Because you will give it to your account, right?
No, we can talk, we can talk, we can talk a little.
Wait for some time, I need some time.
No, take your time, please cut it later. After you said all this, I felt a bit strange, that's why I asked you to cut it.
You are so hurt, that's why I didn't ask for the number immediately.
I was hurt, but I have come out of it. Now I am not hurt.
How to say, it happened like that.
It was just, now I am hurt, if you ask if I am hurt, I am not hurt.
Because I, now, if I expect something from him, then it will hurt me.
But I am not expecting anything.
What did you eat at night?
When will you sleep? When will you wake up in the morning?
I am awake today, tomorrow, I won't be awake tomorrow, I will tell you. Every day is a different story.
Sharmila, cut it and don't go, share the number and go, please.
But I can't talk, are you okay with that?
No, I will message you, you can call me when you are free, I have no problem.
I will repeat the number once.
A baby photo will be there.
Yes, the message has come, is the DP there?
Yes, yes, I got the number. DP is not there.
Wait, I will save it, I have already messaged you.
I haven't shared my number with anyone yet.
I will tell you how to call me, what, everything in detail on WhatsApp.
I am a little scared, this is the first time I have done this with anyone.
Oh, I won't torture you, I won't do anything.
One minute, I will call you on that, WhatsApp call or voice call?
Don't do it, don't do it, don't do it.
